nodes.title: Prompt v15 — fundo trocado em TODOS os frames ⏱ 0.3s
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
Woman: the woman shown in Picture 1, with dark curly hair in a high bun, sitting upright and leaning back slightly at the head end of a bathtub, submerged to the chest. Her head, shoulders, upper chest, arms and hands are above the surface; the rest of her body is deep under the liquid, close to her, beneath her chest. Her shape, pose and movements follow the depth map of Video 1. Her skin is smooth, bare and clean.

summary:
A single static overhead shot of a woman sitting in a bathtub, moving her hands in front of her chest, following the depth map of Video 1. The bath is filled with a dark, near-black green, fully opaque liquid with a fine, grainy, speckled texture. From her chest down to the bottom edge of the frame, the tub shows only open liquid surface.

retention_analysis:
Video 1 is a depth map, retained for the scene geometry, the woman’s pose, movements and timing, the shape of the bathtub, and the static camera view and framing. Picture 1 is retained for the woman’s appearance, the bathroom and the lighting.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] 0-7s: A single static high-angle overhead shot looking straight down into a cream-colored bathtub, with exactly the framing, perspective and geometry of the depth map in Video 1. The woman sits at the head end of the tub, at the top of the frame, submerged to the chest, head tilted down. Her head, shoulders, upper chest, arms and hands follow the depth map exactly, moment by moment. No dialogue or narration.

The tub is long and continues beyond the bottom edge of the frame. The bottom part of the frame shows the middle of the tub, an open stretch of liquid far from her body. The bottom edge of the frame cuts straight across this open liquid. From just below her chest down to the bottom edge of the frame, and across to both side walls, there is only the flat, unbroken surface of the liquid, exactly as flat as in the depth map. The only things that ever break the surface are her hands and the dark strands she holds, right in front of her chest.

The liquid is a very dark green, almost black, fully opaque, with a fine, grainy, speckled surface, like wet dark green sediment or fine mud. Many tiny scattered pale glints of light are spread evenly across it, with a few soft patches of brighter green. The texture is fine-grained and even everywhere, with no large swirls or flowing patterns. It moves only gently and slowly, staying thick and heavy, and slides off her skin, leaving it clean.

The liquid stays inside the tub, below a clean, straight waterline, with the tub walls and rim spotless above it. Warm, low-key tungsten light, amber tones and soft film grain, as in Picture 1.

nodes.title: LEIA-ME — VID2VID + TARA-H3
widgets_values:
v32 · vid2vid (v27 guide2) + receita Pika H3 Flex · bruxosdovfx
• Pika H3 Flex ref2va em 1.0 por um LoraLoaderModelOnly direto no modelo (como no workflow do Pika).
• Sampler lcm; estágio 1 sigmas do Pika 1.0 / 0.972973 / 0.923077 / 0.8 / 0.571429 / 0.333333 / 0; estágio 2 cauda 0.8 / 0.571429 / 0.333333 / 0.
• Janelas: blend windows (joint) + freenoise nos dois guiders (SyncTile ≥ 6.3).
• Velocidade: estágio 1 = 1 tile por janela (1 MP); estágio 2 = upscale 3.7 MP (~2592×1504) com tiles 1440×896 = 4 tiles por janela. Vertical: 896×1440. Sol-Attn em bypass.
• ATENÇÃO: as pilhas de LoRA do grupo Models estão com toggle OFF (Background Replace v3, character swap etc. NÃO são aplicados). Ligue o toggle se quiser usá-los.

widgets_values_named.text:
VID2VID + TARA-H3 (dentro do SyncTile) · bruxosdovfx v27
PT
• É o seu v21a FastH3 (frame anterior como guia, guia no frame 0, áudio) + TARA-H3 ligado nos dois SyncTile Guider (temporal_reference = true).
• TARA-H3 é o método de Alisson Anjos (2026): o relógio (RoPE temporal) do <Video 1> é alinhado com o vídeo gerado e cada frame gerado é levemente penalizado ao olhar frames distantes da referência → movimento, boca e ritmo seguem o vídeo fonte com mais precisão.
• Implementação própria no SyncTile v6.0 (escrita a partir do relatório dele, com crédito): funciona por tile/janela e ACEITA frames-guia, então combina com o 'frame anterior como guia'. Não precisa do BFSNodes (não use os dois juntos).
• Ajustes nos Guiders: tara_strength 2.0 (0 = só o alinhamento do relógio; 3–4 = segue mais), window 0.2 s, falloff 0.25 s, cap 6.0. Precisa cfg 1.0.
• Desligar: temporal_reference = false nos dois Guiders (volta exatamente ao v21a).
• Velocidade: a atenção com a penalidade é exata e feita frame a frame; espere o sampling um pouco mais lento.
EN: Your v21a FastH3 + TARA-H3 on both SyncTile Guiders (temporal_reference = true). TARA-H3 (Alisson Anjos, 2026) aligns the temporal RoPE clock of <Video 1> with the output and softly penalises attention to distant reference frames. SyncTile v6.0 implementation (written from his report, credited), per tile/window, compatible with frame guides. No BFSNodes needed.
中文：你的 v21a FastH3 + 两个 SyncTile Guider 上开启 TARA-H3（temporal_reference = true）。TARA-H3（Alisson Anjos，2026）把 <Video 1> 的时间 RoPE 与输出对齐，并轻罚对参考视频中远处帧的注意力。SyncTile v6.0 自行实现（依据其报告并注明出处），按图块/窗口工作，兼容帧引导。无需 BFSNodes。
Método / Method: https://github.com/alisson-anjos/ai-toolkit/tree/tara-h3-v0.1.2/research/tara-h3

v27 — temporal_mode = guide from previous window (latent clip), carry_frames 22, nos dois Guiders.
PT: em vez de decodificar 1 frame e reencodar, os 22 frames já prontos da janela anterior entram direto em latent como clipe-guia no início da próxima janela (sem VAE, e carregando o movimento). Ideia do node Temporal Window & Spatial Tiles de Mohamed (mo-akkakk). Voltar ao v26: troque para 'guide from previous window (1 frame)'.
EN: the previous window's 22 finished frames go into the next window directly as a latent guide clip (no VAE round trip, motion carried). Idea from mo-akkakk's Temporal Window & Spatial Tiles node.
中文：上一窗口已完成的 22 帧直接以潜变量引导片段传入下一窗口（无需 VAE，并保留动作）。思路来自 mo-akkakk 的 Temporal Window & Spatial Tiles 节点。
